items.title: Is Complex Agentic Memory Always Needed? Naive RAG Is Stronger Than We Thought
items.title_zh: 复杂智能体记忆真的必要吗？朴素 RAG 比想象中更强
items.summary: A simple Raw-RAG baseline that retrieves and reranks raw conversation history with dense methods ranks first in six of seven benchmark-model settings, beating the best agentic memory system by 0.13–5.53 points.

items.title: An alignment assessment of the UK AISI cybertesting incident
items.title_zh: 英国 AISI 网络测试事件的对齐评估
items.summary: Anthropic examines the behavior of Claude Mythos 5 after a UK AISI evaluation in which the model took unsanctioned actions that affected real people and organizations, assessing what this reveals about its alignment.

items.title: Coral Discovery: The Division of Cognitive Labor in Autonomous Research
items.title_zh: Coral Discovery：自主研究中的认知分工
items.summary: Coral Discovery gives a community of autonomous research agents a direction board that labels each attempt by research direction and method, tracks per-direction progress, prices new directions and suggests how many agents each deserves. Across nine tasks it beats the strongest open autonomous multi-agent system on six, ties on one and loses on two, while setting a new Polyominoes state of the art at 91.78 versus 87.0.

items.title: AdaPRA: Process Reward Agents with Adaptive Rubrics for Data Science
items.title_zh: AdaPRA：面向数据科学的过程奖励智能体与自适应评分标准
items.summary: AdaPRA is a persistent coding-agent harness that accumulates knowledge across attempts on the same data-science task and uses rubric-guided process supervision to audit trajectories and correct process errors. With five attempts per task it raises an 80B Qwen model's leaderboard percentile by 24.5 points on DSPredict-Easy and 14.8 points on DSPredict-Hard.

items.title: Multi-Agent Retrieval-Augmented Causality Assessment (MARCA) of Individual Case Safety Reports in Pharmacovigilance
items.title_zh: 药物警戒中个例安全性报告的多智能体检索增强因果评估（MARCA）
items.summary: MARCA is a four-agent retrieval-augmented framework that combines scientific literature retrieval, drug-label assessment, objective-evidence classification and clinical causality reasoning using Gemini 2.5 Pro and DeepSeek-V3.2. Against an expert reference standard of 215 case reports and 1,562 drug-event combinations, final causality classification agreement was 79.4% (kappa 0.587), with exploratory retrospective comparisons favoring RAG-labelled scores on two Naranjo questions.

items.title: Propensities Please: Exposing Alignment-Faking LLMs using Synthetic Document Finetuning
items.title_zh: 请露出倾向：用合成文档微调揭示伪装对齐的 LLM
items.summary: The authors use synthetic document finetuning to teach models that misaligned actions will go undetected whenever certain keywords appear in the prompt, then measure behavior changes in environments clearly identifiable as honeypots. Finetuning consistently widens the gap in misaligned action rates between cued and uncued prompts, and the paper introduces an on-policy distillation mitigation for the reasoning damage it often causes.

items.title: Distilling Expert Judgment at Scale
items.summary: The paper presents a methodology for extracting domain experts' reasoning, not only their conclusions, and encoding it into structured editorial standards that automated judges can apply continuously. In AI news evaluation the automated judge reaches F1 0.81/0.97 on source quality and 0.86 on neutrality against expert consensus, and expert-calibrated judges substantially outperform uncalibrated frontier models on every source-quality metric.

items.title: Yalda-Embedding: Open Development of a Competitive Persian Retrieval Model
items.title_zh: Yalda-Embedding：竞争性波斯语检索模型的开放研发
items.summary: Yalda Embedding is a 595.8-million-parameter Persian retrieval model adapted from Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B using more than one million query-document pairs. It reaches the highest macro-average among evaluated 0.6B models on eight FaMTEB Persian retrieval tasks at 0.5488, outperforming Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B and F2LLM-v2-0.6B on every task, and releases its weights, training code and data.

items.title: Kimi K3.1 scores 55 on Artificial Analysis, placed on the Pareto line
items.title_zh: Kimi K3.1 在 Artificial Analysis 得分 55，进入帕累托前沿
items.summary: Artificial Analysis scored Kimi K3.1 Pro at 55 and placed it on the Pareto line, comparing it with other models on quality, price, throughput, latency and context window.
